name: PlainQAFact
description: A factuality evaluation framework trained on the PlainFact dataset to assess the factuality of biomedical plain language summaries, especially handling elaborative explanations that add external content.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the biomedical factuality literature; it is too new to have broad community adoption yet, but it targets an important gap in evaluating plain-language summary factuality.
notes: Addresses limitations of existing factuality metrics for plain language summaries; uses retrieval-augmented QA scoring.
